design: comparisons to the noise MS/MS analytical control and random MS/MS statistical control

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is a method validation and instrument comparison (OIT vs LIT) focusing on the accuracy of peptide identification from MS/MS spectra fit versus accurate precursor mass. It does not involve a biological perturbation or differential treatment of samples; it analyzes normal human plasma. Therefore, it is classified as un-classified.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) is explicitly stated in PRIDE metadata. The study focuses on protein identification and enumeration (counting) via observation frequencies, which aligns with label-free quantification (LFQ) principles.

workflow: Text: 'The collection of peptides and proteins identified by OIT and LIT was in qualitative and quantitative agreement... 2726 protein gene symbols'
differential: Text: 'The protein p-values, false discovery rate q-values... confirmed the high-confidence MS/MS identifications'
Text: 'The maximum accepted protein FDR was ≤1% (q ≤ 0.01) false positive rate'
search_parameters: Text: 'modifications such as the oxidation of methionine (M) or tryptophan (W) (15.994915), the addition of +1 at asparagine (N) or glutamine (Q) (0.984016), and hydroxylation or sulfonation of M or W (31.98983) and glycine (G) substitution at Cysteine (C) (57.021464). The addition of a carboxy-terminal hydroxyl (17.002735) or an amino-terminal proton (1.007825)'

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study specifically investigates the impact of using a wide precursor mass window (±3 Da) to capture heavy isotopes and hydrogen rearrangements versus a strict monoisotopic window (±0.1 Da). This is a methodological comparison of search parameters rather than a biological differential analysis between conditions.

acquisition: all ions above the signal threshold were submitted for MS/MS (AGC target 5e4, maximum injection time of 50 ms) in order of decreasing intensity with previously selected ions dynamically excluded for 60s
labeling: quantified from MS/MS spectra alone without the need for an accurate measure of the precursor mass
specialized: intact plasma proteins were collected over 100 μL of Quaternary amine (QA) also called Strong Anion Exchange (SAX) resin
partition chromatography performed better than depletion chromatography

MStype_prompt.notes: The study focuses on the validity of using a wide precursor mass tolerance (±3 Da) to identify peptides from human plasma, specifically accounting for heavy isotopes and hydrogen rearrangements. No specific PTM-enrichment modifiers (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used; the 'enrichment' was general protein capture via SAX resin.

Treatment_prompt.reasoning: Identification of proteins from normal human plasma by LC-MSMS with linear ion trap after collection over quaternary amine resin and digestion with trypsin.
